👥 Sharing and teams:
🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Teams admin alerts for bot submissions
🤝 Team-shared Bot announcement
🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Team bot manager intro
💾 Saved bots per team
🔒 Creations stay private until shared
💬 Team admin can turn off bot texting

💬 Chat:
🤖 Group chat Grok
📣 iMessage group chats

🗺️ Places and bookings:

🔌 Connectors:

🔌 Service account vs official integration

📊 Refer a friend
✨ Archived tasks
